title: Microscale Pore Analysis Using Broad Beam Ion Milling of Free Surfaces
content: Quantification of small pores in can be difficult, as cross-sectioning and mechanically polishing the material tends to obscure the smallest pores in ductile materials. The pore characteristics are important to functional applications such as filtration and catalysis, so careful sample preparation is critical. An effective method for “damage-free” cross-sectional polishing is focused ion beam (FIB) milling, which preserves the interior features of the porous metal. This method has been used successfully, but the equipment investment is significant and the setup moderately complex for the average user. Therefore, it is of interest to achieve a quantitatively meaningful pore measurement with minimal effort and specialization.
